domain_compliance.notes: Entidades de dominio alineadas con gestión de pedidos: Order (id, customerId, createdAt, items, status, getTotalAmount), OrderItem (productId, quantity, unitPrice, getLineTotal), Money (amount, currency, add/subtract/multiply), Address (street, city, zipCode, country), OrderStatus (PENDING, PAID, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED). Invariantes implementadas: pedido con al menos un ítem, total = suma lineTotal, mínimo 10.00 para marcar PAID, transiciones de estado (PENDING→PAID→SHIPPED, cancelación solo PENDING/PAID).

test_results.output_summary: BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Tests: domain (Address, Money, OrderItem, Order), application (OrderManagementService), infrastructure (OrderRestController integration, OrderRepository contract), ManagementApplicationTests.
